name: SBA COMMUNICATIONS CORPORATION
moat_justification: Strong tower moat: zoning/permitting scarcity makes existing sites nearly impossible to replicate, long-term leases with fixed escalators, very high incremental margin on colocation (tower cash flow margin 79.5% in Q2 2026), and a three-player US oligopoly (AMT/CCI/SBAC) serving carriers who cannot easily relocate equipment. Capped below wide-moat 9-10 because the customer base is only three major US carriers (consolidation already produced Sprint churn, Dish churn follows in 2027-28), pricing is contractual escalators rather than true pricing power, the US market is mature, and 6.4x leverage leaves the equity as a levered claim on slow growth.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Real Estate sector — OE/capex DCF fits real estate names poorly; grade confidence low
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 12.9x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Strong-moat (7/10) tower REIT with contracted escalator growth, but slow growth plus 12.9x net debt/OE cannot clear 15% at $183.72 — Tier D, weighted IRR 7.46%, weighted IV@15 $72.75; clears 15% only below ~$73.
moat_for: Zoning/permitting scarcity — existing towers cannot be replicated
Long-term leases with fixed escalators — contracted, visible revenue
Colocation economics — added tenants drop through at ~79.5% tower cash flow margin
Three-player tower oligopoly (AMT / CCI / SBAC), high carrier switching costs
46,390 sites, scale in international growth markets (Millicom portfolio)
moat_against: Customer concentration — three major US carriers; consolidation drives churn (Sprint, then Dish 2027-28)
No pricing power beyond contractual escalators
Mature US market — domestic site leasing flat in Q2 2026, growth is international/FX-exposed
High leverage — net debt 12.9x normalized OE (6.4x Adj. EBITDA), rate-sensitive REIT equity
Ground-lease renewals and satellite direct-to-cell as long-run erosion forces
